The '''NR-V2 Explorer''' was an exploration [[Droid/Legends|droid]] created by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was based on the design of the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]].
